About - PostEra About Us The Problem The Solution Publications Drug Discovery PostEra Pipeline Pharma Partners COVID Moonshot Join the Team In the News The Problem The Solution Publications The Problem Today, developing medicines for diseases takes too long, is too expensive, and fails too often. The time taken to develop a drug is over 10 years and hasn’t improved over the last decade. How Long How Much The discovery of a drug follows three stages 0 1 Biology Identify relevant biological target(s) associated with the disease. 0 2 Chemistry Develop safe and effective chemical compounds that can hit those targets. 0 3 Medicine Develop these compounds into medicines by showing their effectiveness in the appropriate patients in clinical trials. The Solution PostEra has developed Proton , an end-to-end machine learning platform to close the Design-Make-Test cycle of Medicinal Chemistry PostEra’s current focus is on the Chemistry of drug discovery. Known as Medicinal Chemistry, it constitutes an iterative three-step cycle. At each stage of the cycle we use Proton to solve the key problems. All three stages are important though the Make stage, known as chemical synthesis, is typically the most time consuming step. Proton closes the full cycle by addressing the key challenges at each stage of the process Design We combine our proprietary data with our chemistry foundation models to design molecules that satisfy the many competing properties that drug candidates must satisfy. Make State-of-the-art synthesis and search ensuring that every molecule we design has a reliable synthetic route and that molecules can be made in parallel using shared synthetic intermediates. Test Novel active learning methodologies to gather the most informative data at each cycle. Proton allows PostEra to do faster drug discovery, find more optimized drug candidates, and develop better medicines for patients Our AI is not a black box We've partnered with the world's top pharmaceutical companies to show Proton works in the real world. Responsibilities of the Apprentice: Assist in maintaining statutory registers, minute books, corporate records, and other company secretarial documentation. Support preparation of notices, agendas, minutes, resolutions, extracts, and other documents for board, committee, and shareholder meetings. Assist with e-filings, annual returns, event-based filings, and other submissions with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and other regulators, under supervision. Help maintain regulatory calendars, track statutory deadlines, and coordinate timely completion of routine compliance activities. Support entity management activities, including collation and maintenance of director, shareholder, authorised signatory, and corporate information. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external service providers, including auditors, consultants, lawyers, and company secretarial service providers. Assist with KYC, due diligence, regulatory, audit, and internal governance requests by preparing and organising relevant documentation. Requirements: Candidate should have completed the ICSI Professional Programme and mandatory practical training requirement under ICSI. Strong preference will be given to candidates have completed a degree in Law from a recognized university. Strong interest in company secretarial, corporate governance, compliance, and legal operations. Good drafting skills and ability to prepare clear, accurate, and well-organised documentation. Strong attention to detail, with a process-focused and deadline-conscious approach. Ability to manage multiple tasks, follow up proactively, and seek guidance where required. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate with diverse stakeholders. Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and basic document management tools.
